# JellyHA - Home Assistant Integration for Jellyfin

> JellyHA is a custom integration for Home Assistant providing rich Jellyfin media tracking, Lovelace UI cards, real-time media player entities, chapter and intro/outro segment detection, Chromecast streaming, and powerful automation actions.

This document serves as the authoritative, compact technical specification for AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot) generating Home Assistant automations, scripts, Jinja2 templates, and configurations for JellyHA.

---

## 1. Core Architecture & Entities

### Primary Playback Entity: `media_player.jellyha_<user>`
Each configured Jellyfin user gets a dedicated media player entity (e.g., `media_player.jellyha_admin`).
* **States**: `playing`, `paused`, `idle`, `off`
* **Standard HA Attributes**:
  * `media_title`: Current item name (Movie title, Episode title, or Song title)
  * `media_artist`: Artist name (for Audio / MusicVideo)
  * `media_album_name`: Album name (for Audio)
  * `media_content_id`: Jellyfin item GUID
  * `media_content_type`: `movie`, `tvshow`, `music`, or `video`
  * `media_duration`: Total duration in seconds
  * `media_position`: Current playback position in seconds
  * `shuffle`: Boolean (True if shuffle is active)
  * `repeat`: String (`off`, `all`, `one`)
  * `entity_picture`: Authenticated, signed proxy image URL
* **Extra State Attributes** (`state_attr('media_player.jellyha_<user>', 'attribute_name')`):
  * `title`: String (Item title)
  * `series_title`: String (TV series name for episodes, null for movies)
  * `season`: Integer (Season number)
  * `episode`: Integer (Episode number)
  * `year`: Integer (Production release year)
  * `genres`: List of strings
  * `official_rating`: String (e.g. `PG-13`, `TV-MA`, `R`)
  * `community_rating`: Float (0.0 to 10.0 score)
  * `runtime_minutes`: Integer
  * `progress_percent`: Float (0.0 to 100.0)
  * `position_ticks`: Integer (1 second = 10,000,000 ticks)
  * `duration_ticks`: Integer
  * `is_favorite`: Boolean
  * `is_played`: Boolean
  * `media_segment_type`: String or null (`Intro`, `Outro`, `Recap`, `Preview`, `Commercial`)
  * `segment_end_seconds`: Float or null (Exact second when the active segment ends)
  * `media_chapter_name`: String or null (Active chapter title)
  * `media_chapter_index`: Integer (1-indexed chapter number)
  * `media_chapter_count`: Integer (Total chapters in item)
  * `is_last_chapter`: Boolean
  * `series_image_url`: String (Portrait poster of parent series)
  * `backdrop_url`: String (Fanart / backdrop wallpaper URL)
  * `dynamic_range`: String (`SDR`, `HDR10`, `HDR10+`, `Dolby Vision`, `HLG`)
  * `video_range`: String (`HDR`, `SDR`)
  * `video_range_type`: String (e.g. `DOVIWithHDR10`, `DOVIWithEL`, `HDR10Plus`, `HDR10`, `SDR`)
  * `dv_profile`: Integer or null (Dolby Vision profile number, e.g. `7`, `8`, `5`)
  * `video_codec`: String (e.g. `hevc`, `av1`, `h264`)
  * `video_bit_depth`: Integer (`10`, `8`)
  * `supports_remote_control`: Boolean (True if remote controllable, False if non-controllable like mobile ExoPlayer)
  * `entry_id` / `config_entry_id`: String (JellyHA integration instance GUID)

### Client / Device Playback Entity: `media_player.jellyha_<device_name>`
Users can opt-in to dedicated media player entities per physical client device (e.g., `media_player.jellyha_living_room_tv`, `media_player.jellyha_bedroom_shield`) configured in Integration Options.
* **States & Attributes**: 100% attribute parity with per-user media players (all standard HA attributes, extra attributes, chapter/segment detection, dynamic range, and transport controls).
* **Device-Specific Attributes**:
  * `device_id`: Jellyfin physical client device GUID
  * `device_name`: Name of client device
  * `client`: Jellyfin client app name (e.g. `Jellyfin Android TV`, `Jellyfin Web`)
  * `user_name`: Dynamically reflects the Jellyfin username currently watching on this device (or `null` when idle)
  * `user_id`: Dynamically reflects the Jellyfin user ID currently watching on this device
* **Use Case**: Room-based automations (e.g., cinema lighting, motorized shades, pause-on-doorbell) tied to a specific room TV regardless of which family member is logged in.

### Server & Library Sensor Entities:
* `sensor.jellyha_jellyfin_version`: Server version (e.g. `12.0.0`)
* `sensor.jellyha_websocket_status`: WebSocket connection health status (`connected` / `disconnected`)
* `sensor.jellyha_active_sessions`: Count of currently active playback sessions (attribute `sessions` lists session metadata)
* `sensor.jellyha_connected_clients`: Count of all Jellyfin clients currently connected to the server, regardless of play state (attribute `clients` lists `user`, `device`, `client`, `last_activity_date`, `is_playing` per client). JellyHA's own internal session is excluded. Updates in real-time via WebSocket — ideal for Wake-on-LAN automations triggered before playback starts.
* `sensor.jellyha_transcoding_streams`: Count of active media streams currently being transcoded (attribute `transcode_sessions` contains codec, reason, framerate)
* `sensor.jellyha_media_storage_free`: Free storage space on primary media drive in GB (attributes: `free_bytes`, `used_bytes`, `total_bytes`, `free_tb`, `used_percent`)
* `sensor.jellyha_media_storage_free_percentage`: Free storage space percentage on primary media drive (e.g. `62` %)
* `sensor.jellyha_library`: General library aggregate count (attributes: `movies`, `series`, `videos`, `episodes`, `songs`, `albums`, `artists`, `entry_id`)
* `sensor.jellyha_movies`: Total movies in library (attributes: `watched`, `unwatched`, `favorites`)
* `sensor.jellyha_series`: Total TV series in library (attributes: `watched`, `unwatched`, `favorites`, `total_episodes`, `unwatched_episodes`)
* `sensor.jellyha_episodes`: Total episodes count across all shows (attributes: `watched`, `unwatched`)
* `sensor.jellyha_latest_movie`: Title and metadata of the most recently added movie (attributes: `item_id`, `title`, `year`, `overview`, `genres`, `rating`, `runtime_minutes`, `date_added`, `poster_url`, `backdrop_url`, `dynamic_range`, `resolution`, `video_codec`, `container`)
* `sensor.jellyha_latest_episode`: Formatted title and metadata of the most recently added TV episode (attributes: `item_id`, `title`, `series_name`, `series_id`, `season`, `episode`, `year`, `overview`, `genres`, `rating`, `runtime_minutes`, `date_added`, `poster_url`, `series_poster_url`, `backdrop_url`, `dynamic_range`, `resolution`, `video_codec`, `container`)
* `sensor.jellyha_watched`: Total watched content count (attributes: `movies`, `series`, `episodes`, `entry_id`)
* `sensor.jellyha_unwatched`: Total unwatched content count (attributes: `movies`, `series`, `episodes`, `entry_id`)
* `sensor.jellyha_watched_movies`: Fully watched movies count
* `sensor.jellyha_unwatched_movies`: Unwatched movies count
* `sensor.jellyha_watched_series`: Fully watched TV series count
* `sensor.jellyha_unwatched_series`: Unwatched TV series count
* `sensor.jellyha_watched_episodes`: Total watched episodes count across all TV shows
* `sensor.jellyha_unwatched_episodes`: Total unwatched episodes count across all TV shows
* `sensor.jellyha_favorites`: Count of user favorite items
* `sensor.jellyha_live_tv_channels`: Total count of available Live TV channels (attributes: `server_id`, `server_name`, `server_version`, `enabled`, state_class: `measurement`). Only created when `enable_live_tv` is enabled in Options.
* `sensor.jellyha_library_<name>_storage_size`: Disk usage of a specific media library in GB (attributes: `bytes`, `human_readable`, `library_name`, `entry_id`, state_class: `measurement`, device_class: `data_size`)
* `sensor.jellyha_library_<media>_watched_percentage`: Percentage of library content watched (0-100%, attributes: `library_type`, `total_items`, `watched_items`, `entry_id`, state_class: `measurement`)
* `sensor.jellyha_last_refresh`: Timestamp of last API refresh
* `sensor.jellyha_last_library_update`: Timestamp of last detected library update
* `sensor.jellyha_refresh_duration`: Duration of last refresh (e.g. `0.9s`)

### Native Media Browser Support (`/media-browser`)
JellyHA registers a native Home Assistant Media Browser provider for each server instance. When browsing `media_player` entities or the sidebar Media Browser:
* All per-user (`media_player.jellyha_<user>`) and per-device (`media_player.jellyha_<device>`) media players expose `BROWSE_MEDIA` and direct library navigation.
* Displays top-level library folders (Movies, TV Shows, Music), **📦 Collections / BoxSets**, and a dedicated **📡 Live TV** category (when `enable_live_tv` is enabled in Options).
* Inside **📦 Collections**, tapping Play on any BoxSet automatically resolves and plays its first movie.
* Inside **📡 Live TV**, channels are rendered with authenticated signed channel logos, channel numbers, and titles, sorted numerically/alphabetically.
* Tapping any track, album, playlist, or movie starts instant playback directly on the selected media player.

---

## 2. Integration Actions / Services (`jellyha.*`)

All JellyHA services accept `config_entry_id` (or `entity_id` / `server_entity_id`) to target a specific server in multi-instance setups. If omitted, the active instance is automatically resolved.

### 1. `jellyha.play_on_chromecast`
Casts media to a Google Cast / Chromecast / Android TV device with automatic direct-play or optimized transcoding, including subtitle burn-in.
* **Fields**:
  * `entity_id` (Required, string): The target Chromecast `media_player` entity (e.g. `media_player.living_room_tv`).
  * `item_id` (Required, string): Jellyfin item GUID.
  * `subtitle_mode` (Optional, select, default: `auto`): Strategy for subtitle selection:
    * `auto`: Follows the Jellyfin user profile preferences; falls back to English if unconfigured.
    * `none`: Completely disables subtitles.
    * `forced_only`: Only displays forced subtitle tracks (for foreign-language dialogue).
    * `custom`: Checks the languages listed under `subtitle_language` in priority order.
  * `subtitle_language` (Optional, string): Prioritized comma-separated list of language codes or names (e.g. `"sl, en"` or `"slv, eng"`).
  * `use_series_image` (Optional, boolean, default: `true`): For TV episodes, sends the official Series vertical poster to Chromecast instead of the episode thumbnail.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance in multi-server setups.
* **SUBTITLE ENGINE BEHAVIOR**:
  * If a text subtitle track (SRT, VTT) is selected, it is delivered directly to Chromecast without video re-encoding.
  * If a bitmap/graphic subtitle track (PGS, VOBSUB, DVDSUB) is selected, JellyHA automatically instructs Jellyfin to burn the subtitle track directly into the video stream via HLS server-side transcoding (`SubtitleStreamIndex` + `SubtitleMethod=Encode`).
  * Unique `PlaySessionId` tokens ensure Chromecast never caches outdated subtitle manifests across sequential plays.
* **CRITICAL BEHAVIOR FOR TV SHOWS**: If `item_id` is a `Series` (or `Season`), `play_on_chromecast` automatically queries Jellyfin's Next Up queue and casts the **next unplayed episode**! If the series has never been started, it automatically falls back to Season 1 Episode 1.

### 2. `jellyha.search`
Searches the Jellyfin library and returns structured media objects into an automation `response_variable`.
* **Fields**:
  * `query` (Optional, string): Text query searching item titles.
  * `media_type` (Optional, select): `Movie`, `Series`, `Episode`, `Audio`, `MusicAlbum`, `MusicArtist`, `MusicVideo`, `Video`, `Playlist`, `BoxSet`.
  * `sort_by` (Optional, select): `DateCreated` (default), `SortName` (A-Z), `PremiereDate`, `CommunityRating`, `IndexNumber` (Episode/Track number), `DatePlayed`, `PlayCount`, `Random` (Shuffle picker).
  * `sort_order` (Optional, select): `Descending` (default), `Ascending`.
  * `parent_id` or `series_id` (Optional, string): Restricts search *inside* a specific TV series, season, or album GUID.
  * `is_played` (Optional, boolean): Filter by watched status (`true` or `false`).
  * `is_favorite` (Optional, boolean): Filter by user favorite status.
  * `genre` (Optional, string): Filter by genre name (e.g. `Action`, `Comedy`).
  * `year` (Optional, integer): Filter by release year (e.g. `2025`).
  * `min_rating` (Optional, float): Minimum community score (0.0 to 10.0).
  * `official_rating` (Optional, string): Content certification (e.g. `PG`, `PG-13`, `R`, `TV-MA`, `TV-Y`).
  * `studio` (Optional, string): Studio or TV network (e.g. `Pixar`, `HBO`, `Marvel Studios`, `Disney`).
  * `person` (Optional, string): Actor, actress, or director (e.g. `Bryan Cranston`, `Christopher Nolan`).
  * `season` (Optional, integer): Season number (ParentIndexNumber).
  * `episode` (Optional, integer): Episode number (IndexNumber).
  * `offset` (Optional, integer): Number of items to skip (pagination).
  * `limit` (Optional, integer, default 5): Maximum items to return.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.
* **Return Structure**:
  Returns a dictionary `{"items": [...]}` where each item contains:
  * `id`: Jellyfin item GUID
  * `name`: Item title (Episode title for episodes, Movie title for movies, Show title for series)
  * `type`: Media type (`Movie`, `Series`, `Episode`, etc.)
  * `year`: Release year
  * `rating`: Community rating (0-10)
  * `season`: Season number (for episodes)
  * `episode`: Episode number (for episodes)
  * `series_name`: Parent series title (for episodes)
  * `series_id`: Parent series GUID (for episodes)
  * `is_played`: Boolean
  * `is_favorite`: Boolean
  * `runtime_minutes`: Integer
  * `dynamic_range`: String (`SDR`, `HDR10`, `Dolby Vision`, `HLG`)
  * `video_range`: String (`HDR`, `SDR`)
  * `video_range_type`: String (e.g. `DOVIWithHDR10`, `HDR10`, `SDR`)
  * `video_codec`: String (e.g. `hevc`, `av1`)
  * `video_bit_depth`: Integer (`10`, `8`)
  * `dv_profile`: Integer (Dolby Vision profile number)
  * `poster_url`, `image_url`, `backdrop_url`, `jellyfin_url`
  * `path`, `filepath`: Absolute server file path on disk (e.g. `"/media/movies/Inception.mkv"`)

### 3. `jellyha.session_control`
Controls a Jellyfin playback session directly.
* **Fields**:
  * `session_id` (Required, string): Session ID.
  * `command` (Required, select): `Pause`, `Unpause`, `TogglePause`, `Stop`, `NextTrack`, `PreviousTrack`, `Shuffle`, `SetRepeatMode`.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target instance.

### 4. `jellyha.session_seek`
Seeks to a specific timestamp in a Jellyfin session.
* **Fields**:
  * `session_id` (Required, string): Session ID.
  * `position_ticks` (Optional, integer): Position in ticks (1 sec = 10,000,000 ticks. Use `0` to restart).
  * `position_seconds` (Optional, float): Position in seconds (automatically converted to ticks).
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target instance.

### 5. `jellyha.session_play`
Instructs an active Jellyfin client session or device player to play a media item (Movie, Episode, Song, etc.). Automatically resolves TV shows to the next unplayed episode.
* **Fields**:
  * `item_id` (Required, string): Jellyfin item GUID to play.
  * `entity_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA media player entity (e.g. `media_player.jellyha_android_tv`).
  * `device_name` (Optional, string): Client device name (e.g. `Android TV`).
  * `device_id` (Optional, string): Client device GUID.
  * `client` (Optional, string): Client app name (e.g. `Wholphin`, `Jellyfin Web`).
  * `session_id` (Optional, string): Direct Jellyfin session ID.
  * `play_command` (Optional, select): `PlayNow` (default), `PlayNext`, `PlayLast`.
  * `start_position_ticks` (Optional, integer): Start position in ticks (1 sec = 10,000,000 ticks).
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target instance.

### 6. `jellyha.session_general_command`
Sends arbitrary general commands to a Jellyfin playback session (e.g. subtitle switching, audio track changes, messages).
* **Fields**:
  * `session_id` (Required, string): Active Jellyfin session ID.
  * `command` (Required, string): General command name (e.g. `SetSubtitleStreamIndex`, `SetAudioStreamIndex`, `Mute`, `Unmute`, `SetVolume`, `DisplayMessage`).
  * `arguments` (Optional, object/map): Key-value arguments dictionary.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target instance.

### 7. `jellyha.mark_watched` & `jellyha.update_favorite`
* `jellyha.mark_watched`: `item_id` (Required, string), `is_played` (Required, boolean), `entity_id` / `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string).
* `jellyha.update_favorite`: `item_id` (Required, string), `is_favorite` (Required, boolean), `entity_id` / `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string).

### 8. `jellyha.delete_item`, `jellyha.get_item`, `jellyha.get_recommendations`
* `jellyha.delete_item`: `item_id` (Required, string) — deletes item from library/disk.
* `jellyha.get_item`: `item_id` (Required, string) — returns full item metadata into `response_variable`.
* `jellyha.get_recommendations`: `item_id` (Required, string), `limit` (Optional, integer) — returns similar items into `response_variable`.

### 9. `jellyha.play_live_tv_channel`
Resolves a Live TV channel by exact channel number or normalized channel name, then tunes the target Jellyfin playback session or media player entity to it.
* **Fields**:
  * `channel_number` (Optional, string): Exact channel number (e.g. `"3"`). One of `channel_number` or `channel_name` is required.
  * `channel_name` (Optional, string): Display name or normalized name (e.g. `"Comedy Central"` or `"comedycentral"`). One of `channel_number` or `channel_name` is required.
  * `entity_id` / `session_id` / `device_name` / `device_id` / `client` (Optional, string): Target playback entity, active session, or client device.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.

### 10. `jellyha.get_live_tv_channels`
Retrieves available Live TV channels from Jellyfin into an automation `response_variable`, with optional text query filtering and pagination limit.
* **Fields**:
  * `query` (Optional, string): Filter channels by name or channel number.
  * `limit` (Optional, integer): Maximum number of channels to return.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` / `entity_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.
* **Return Structure**:
  Returns a dictionary `{"channels": [...]}` where each item contains:
  * `id`: Jellyfin channel item GUID
  * `name`: Channel display name (e.g. `"HBO HD"`)
  * `number`: Channel number string (e.g. `"104"`)
  * `normalized_name`: Normalized alphanumeric lowercase string (e.g. `"hbohd"`)

### 11. `jellyha.music_search`
High-performance indexed music search for tracks, albums, or artists with FLAC, ALAC, and Hi-Res audio specifications. Avoids unindexed SQLite table scans and returns results into `response_variable`.
* **Fields**:
  * `query` (Optional, string): Search text for track title, album, or artist.
  * `search_type` (Optional, string, default: `"all"`): `"all"`, `"track"`, `"song"`, `"album"`, `"artist"`.
  * `artist` (Optional, string): Filter by artist name.
  * `album` (Optional, string): Filter by album title.
  * `genre` (Optional, string): Filter by music genre.
  * `year` (Optional, integer): Filter by release year.
  * `codec` (Optional, string): Filter by audio codec (e.g. `flac`, `alac`, `mp3`, `aac`, `opus`, `dsd`, `wav`).
  * `is_hi_res` (Optional, boolean): Filter for high-resolution audio (24-bit+ or >48kHz or DSD).
  * `is_lossless` (Optional, boolean): Filter for lossless audio formats (FLAC, ALAC, WAV, DSD).
  * `is_favorite` (Optional, boolean): Filter by favorite status.
  * `sort_by` (Optional, string, default: `"SortName"`): `"SortName"`, `"AlbumArtist"`, `"Album"`, `"DateCreated"`, `"PremiereDate"`, `"PlayCount"`, `"Random"`.
  * `sort_order` (Optional, string, default: `"Ascending"`): `"Ascending"`, `"Descending"`.
  * `limit` (Optional, integer, default: 20): Maximum number of results.
  * `offset` (Optional, integer, default: 0): Pagination offset.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` / `entity_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance (defaults to Music instance via smart multi-instance routing).
* **Return Structure**:
  Returns a dictionary `{"items": [...]}` where each item contains:
  * `id`: Item GUID
  * `name`: Track, album, or artist name
  * `type`: `"Audio"`, `"MusicAlbum"`, or `"MusicArtist"`
  * `artist_name`, `album_artist`: Artist names
  * `album`, `album_id`: Parent album details
  * `track_number`, `disc_number`: Track index and disc number
  * `duration_seconds`, `runtime_minutes`: Track duration
  * `stream_url`: Direct bitstream URL for bit-perfect streaming
  * `path`, `filepath`: Physical server file path
  * `audio_codec`: Audio format (e.g. `flac`, `alac`, `mp3`)
  * `audio_bit_depth`: Bit depth (e.g. `24`, `16`)
  * `audio_sample_rate`: Sample rate in Hz (e.g. `96000`, `44100`)
  * `audio_channels`, `audio_channel_layout`: Channel configuration (e.g. `2`, `"stereo"`)
  * `is_lossless`, `is_hi_res`: Boolean flags
  * `audio_quality_label`: Human-readable badge (e.g. `"24-bit / 96 kHz FLAC (Hi-Res Lossless)"`)

### 12. `jellyha.play_music`
Search and play music from Jellyfin directly on any Home Assistant media player (e.g. `media_player.kitchen_speaker`, Sonos, Cast, Wiim, HomePod). Designed for voice assistants (Assist / LLMs) and 1-tap automations.
* **Fields**:
  * `entity_id` (Required, string): Target Home Assistant media player entity to play the music on.
  * `query` (Optional, string): Song title or text to search for.
  * `artist` (Optional, string): Artist name.
  * `album` (Optional, string): Album title.
  * `search_type` (Optional, string, default: `"track"`): `"track"`, `"album"`.
  * `codec` (Optional, string): Filter by audio codec.
  * `is_hi_res` (Optional, boolean): Play only if Hi-Res audio.
  * `is_lossless` (Optional, boolean): Play only if lossless.
  * `item_id` (Optional, string): Direct Jellyfin track or album ID (bypasses search).
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance (auto-selects Music instance in multi-instance setups).

### 13. `jellyha.play_playlist`
Plays a playlist from Jellyfin on any Home Assistant media player or directly on an active Jellyfin client session, with optional shuffle.
* **Fields**:
  * `entity_id` (Required, string): Target media player entity to play the playlist on (HA player or Jellyfin player).
  * `playlist` (Required, string): Name or Jellyfin Item ID of the playlist.
  * `shuffle` (Optional, boolean, default: `false`): Randomize track order before playing.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.
* **Dual Playback Strategy**:
  * When targeting a Jellyfin client session (`media_player.jellyha_*`), delegates server-side queueing via `api.session_play` (`play_command="PlayNow"`), queuing the full playlist natively on Jellyfin client apps.
  * When targeting an external Home Assistant media player (Sonos, Google Cast, Wiim, HomePod), resolves direct stream URLs, attaches cover art and metadata, and handles shuffling.

### 14. `jellyha.get_playlists`
Fetches user playlists from Jellyfin into `response_variable`.
* **Fields**:
  * `query` (Optional, string): Optional search filter to match playlist names.
  * `limit` (Optional, integer): Maximum number of playlists to return.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` / `entity_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.
* **Return Structure**:
  Returns a dictionary `{"playlists": [...]}` where each item contains `id`, `name`, `item_count`, `duration_seconds`, `duration_formatted`, and `image_url`.

### 15. `jellyha.get_collections`
Fetches all BoxSets / Movie Collections from Jellyfin into `response_variable`.
* **Fields**:
  * `query` (Optional, string): Optional search filter to match collection names.
  * `limit` (Optional, integer): Maximum number of collections to return.
  * `include_items` (Optional, boolean, default: `false`): Include contained movies in the response.
  * `server_entity_id` / `config_entry_id` / `entity_id` (Optional, string): Target JellyHA instance.
* **Return Structure**:
  Returns a dictionary `{"collections": [...]}` where each item contains `id`, `name`, `item_count`, `image_url`, and optional `items` list (`id`, `name`, `year`, `runtime`, `image_url`).

---

## 3. Events & Device Triggers

JellyHA fires custom events on the Home Assistant bus for ambient lighting and auto-skip automations:

### Event: `media_segment_change`
Fires when entering or exiting an Intro, Outro, Recap, Preview, or Commercial segment.
* **Trigger syntax**:
  ```yaml
  trigger:
    - trigger: event
      event_type: jellyha_event
      event_data:
        type: media_segment_change
  ```
* **Payload attributes (`trigger.event.data`)**:
  * `in_segment`: Boolean (`true` when entering, `false` when exiting)
  * `segment_type`: String (`Intro`, `Outro`, `Recap`, `Preview`, `Commercial`)
  * `segment_end_seconds`: Float (Exact timeline position when segment ends)
  * `current_position_seconds`: Float
  * `item_id`: Jellyfin item GUID
  * `session_id`: Jellyfin session GUID
  * `title`: Media title
  * `series_title`: Show name (if episode)

### Event: `media_chapter_change`
Fires when the media crosses into a new chapter.
* **Trigger syntax**:
  ```yaml
  trigger:
    - trigger: event
      event_type: jellyha_event
      event_data:
        type: media_chapter_change
  ```
* **Payload attributes (`trigger.event.data`)**:
  * `chapter_name`: String (e.g. `Chapter 1`, `Prologue`)
  * `chapter_index`: Integer (1-indexed)
  * `chapter_count`: Integer
  * `is_last_chapter`: Boolean
  * `item_id`: Jellyfin item GUID

---

## 4. Critical AI Gotchas & Common Hallucinations

When generating automations for JellyHA, you **MUST NEVER** make the following common errors:

1. **`show_title` is NOT an automation parameter**:
   * *The Mistake*: Calling `jellyha.play_on_chromecast` or `jellyha.search` with `show_title: "Breaking Bad"`.
   * *The Reality*: `show_title` is strictly a frontend Lovelace card boolean toggle (`show_title: true/false`).
   * *The Correct Way*: To search for a show, use `jellyha.search` with `query: "Breaking Bad"` and `media_type: Series`.

2. **Episode `name` vs Show `series_name`**:
   * *The Mistake*: Searching for an episode of a show using `jellyha.search` with `query: "Breaking Bad"` and `media_type: Episode`.
   * *The Reality*: An episode's `name` is its individual episode title (e.g. `"Ozymandias"`), NOT the series name! Jellyfin will return 0 results because no episode is titled "Breaking Bad".
   * *The Correct Way*:
     * *For next unplayed episode*: Pass the Series ID directly to `jellyha.play_on_chromecast`!
     * *For a specific episode name*: Search the Series first to get its ID, then search `media_type: Episode` with `parent_id: series_id` and `query: episode_title`.

3. **`sensor.jellyha_now_playing_<user>` is DEPRECATED**:
   * *The Mistake*: Directing playback controls or state checks to the legacy sensor.
   * *The Reality*: Always use `media_player.jellyha_<user>`. Standard HA actions (`media_player.media_play`, `media_player.media_pause`, `media_player.media_seek`, `media_player.shuffle_set`, `media_player.repeat_set`) work out-of-the-box.

4. **Series Playback on Chromecast**:
   * *The Mistake*: Writing complex scripts to fetch all episodes, filter watched ones, and pick one.
   * *The Reality*: Simply pass the **Series GUID** to `jellyha.play_on_chromecast`. The backend handles Next Up resolution and unstarted series fallback automatically.

5. **Ticks vs Seconds**:
   * Jellyfin ticks: `1 second = 10,000,000 ticks`.
   * `jellyha.session_seek` takes `position_ticks`.
   * Standard `media_player.media_seek` takes **seconds**.
   * Event payload `segment_end_seconds` is in **seconds**.

6. **Parsing `jellyha.search` Response**:
   * Always capture with `response_variable: result_name`.
   * The list of items is at `result_name.items`.
   * Always check `result_name.items | count > 0` before indexing `[0]`.

7. **Library Card (`custom:jellyha-library-card`) Scope**:
   * *The Mistake*: Attempting to display Music, Live TV, Playlists, or Collections in the Library Card.
   * *The Reality*: The Library Card is exclusively dedicated to **Movies** and **TV Shows** (`media_type: movies`, `series`, `episodes`, or `both`). Music, Live TV, Playlists, and BoxSets/Collections are accessed via Home Assistant's native Media Browser (`/media-browser`), all media player entities, or dedicated playback actions (`jellyha.play_music`, `jellyha.play_playlist`, `jellyha.play_live_tv_channel`).

8. **Media Player Browsing**:
   * All JellyHA media players (`media_player.jellyha_<user>` and `media_player.jellyha_<device>`) support native media browsing (`MediaPlayerEntityFeature.BROWSE_MEDIA`), allowing users to browse their libraries directly from media player cards.

---

## 5. Canonical Automation Examples

### Example A: Physical NFC Cartridge Player for TV Shows (Stock Pots / Tags)
Plays the next unplayed episode of a series when an NFC cartridge is scanned:
```yaml
alias: "Play TV Cartridge"
trigger:
  - trigger: tag
    tag_id: "your_nfc_tag_id"
action:
  # Passing the Series ID automatically plays the next unplayed episode!
  - action: jellyha.play_on_chromecast
    data:
      entity_id: media_player.living_room_tv
      item_id: "78234782348723487234" # Jellyfin Series ID
```

### Example B: Search and Play Specific Series & Episode Name
Finds a TV show and a specific episode title by text search:
```yaml
alias: "Search and Play Specific Episode"
variables:
  target_series: "Dexter: New Blood"
  target_episode: "Cold Snap"
action:
  # 1. Search for Series
  - action: jellyha.search
    data:
      query: "{{ target_series }}"
      media_type: Series
      limit: 1
    response_variable: show_result

  # 2. Search for Episode inside that Series using parent_id
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ show_result.items | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: jellyha.search
        data:
          query: "{{ target_episode }}"
          media_type: Episode
          parent_id: "{{ show_result.items[0].id }}"
          limit: 1
        response_variable: ep_result

      - if:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ ep_result.items | count > 0 }}"
        then:
          - action: jellyha.play_on_chromecast
            data:
              entity_id: media_player.living_room_tv
              item_id: "{{ ep_result.items[0].id }}"
```

### Example C: Auto-Skip Intro
Seeks directly past the intro when an Intro marker is detected:
```yaml
alias: "Auto-Skip TV Intro"
mode: single
trigger:
  - trigger: event
    event_type: jellyha_event
    event_data:
      type: media_segment_change
condition:
  - condition: template
    value_template: >
      {{ trigger.event.data.in_segment == true and 
         trigger.event.data.segment_type == 'Intro' and 
         trigger.event.data.segment_end_seconds is not none }}
action:
  - action: media_player.media_seek
    target:
      entity_id: media_player.jellyha_admin
    data:
      seek_position: "{{ trigger.event.data.segment_end_seconds + 1 }}"
```

### Example D: Cinema Lighting by Playback State & Segment
Dims room lights on play, turns lights warm on pause, and raises them for end credits:
```yaml
alias: "Cinema Lighting"
mode: restart
trigger:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: media_player.jellyha_admin
    to: "playing"
    id: "playing"
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: media_player.jellyha_admin
    to: "paused"
    id: "paused"
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: media_player.jellyha_admin
    to: "idle"
    id: "stopped"
  - trigger: event
    event_type: jellyha_event
    event_data:
      type: media_segment_change
    id: "segment"
action:
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: "segment"
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ trigger.event.data.in_segment == true and trigger.event.data.segment_type == 'Outro' }}"
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.living_room
            data:
              brightness_pct: 35
              transition: 3

      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: "playing"
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.living_room
            data:
              brightness_pct: 10
              transition: 2

      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: "paused"
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.living_room
            data:
              brightness_pct: 40
              color_temp_kelvin: 2700
              transition: 1

      - conditions:
          - condition: trigger
            id: "stopped"
        sequence:
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.living_room
            data:
              brightness_pct: 100
              transition: 2
```

### Example E: Cast Random Unwatched Top-Rated Movie
Picks a random unwatched movie rated above 7 from a specific year:
```yaml
alias: "Play Random 2025 Top Movie"
action:
  - action: jellyha.search
    data:
      media_type: Movie
      is_played: false
      year: 2025
      min_rating: 7.0
      sort_by: Random
      limit: 1
    response_variable: movie_search

  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ movie_search.items | count > 0 }}"
    then:
      - action: jellyha.play_on_chromecast
        data:
          entity_id: media_player.living_room_tv
          item_id: "{{ movie_search.items[0].id }}"
```

### Example F: TV Picture Mode & Ambient Bias Lighting by Dynamic Range
Automatically switches your TV or AVR picture mode and sets bias lighting intensity based on playback format (`Dolby Vision`, `HDR10`, `HLG`, or `SDR`):
```yaml
alias: "Jellyfin Dynamic Range Mode Sync"
description: "Sync TV picture preset and bias lights based on Dolby Vision/HDR/SDR stream format"
mode: restart
trigger:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: media_player.jellyha_living_room_tv
    to: "playing"
condition:
  - condition: template
    value_template: "{{ state_attr('media_player.jellyha_living_room_tv', 'dynamic_range') is not none }}"
action:
  - variables:
      hdr_format: "{{ state_attr('media_player.jellyha_living_room_tv', 'dynamic_range') }}"
  - choose:
      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ hdr_format == 'Dolby Vision' }}"
        sequence:
          - action: select.select_option
            target:
              entity_id: select.living_room_tv_picture_mode
            data:
              option: "Dolby Vision Dark"
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.tv_bias_lighting
            data:
              brightness_pct: 15
              color_temp_kelvin: 6500

      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ hdr_format in ['HDR10', 'HLG'] }}"
        sequence:
          - action: select.select_option
            target:
              entity_id: select.living_room_tv_picture_mode
            data:
              option: "Cinema HDR"
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.tv_bias_lighting
            data:
              brightness_pct: 20
              color_temp_kelvin: 6500

      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ hdr_format == 'SDR' }}"
        sequence:
          - action: select.select_option
            target:
              entity_id: select.living_room_tv_picture_mode
            data:
              option: "ISF Expert Dark"
          - action: light.turn_on
            target:
              entity_id: light.tv_bias_lighting
            data:
              brightness_pct: 30
              color_temp_kelvin: 6500

### Example G: Home Assistant Voice / Assist Live TV Channel Tuning
Directly tunes live TV channels using Voice Assist conversation trigger:
```yaml
alias: "Voice: Tune Live TV Channel"
description: "Tunes TV to requested channel name or number via voice commands"
mode: single
trigger:
  - trigger: conversation
    command:
      - "Tune to {channel}"
      - "Watch {channel}"
      - "Switch to channel {channel}"
      - "Put on {channel}"
action:
  - action: jellyha.play_live_tv_channel
    data:
      channel_name: "{{ trigger.slots.channel }}"
      entity_id: media_player.jellyha_living_room_tv
  - set_conversation_response: "Tuning to {{ trigger.slots.channel }}."
```

---

## 6. Lovelace Card Actions & Custom Script Calling (`call-service`)

The `jellyha-library-card` and `jellyha-now-playing-card` provide rich UI and automation integration:

### Library Card TV Content Options
* `tv_content`: `'series'` (default) or `'episodes'`. Choose whether TV show libraries display full series poster cards or individual Next Up / latest episodes.
* `use_series_image`: `true` or `false` (default). When viewing episodes, toggle between episode screen-capture thumbnails and parent series portrait cover art.

### Library Card Cast & Subtitle Options
* `default_cast_device`: Target Chromecast `media_player` entity ID (e.g. `'media_player.living_room_tv'`) used when action is set to `cast`. Filtered strictly to Google Cast endpoints in the visual editor.
* `subtitle_mode`: Subtitle strategy for casting and browser playback: `'auto'` (default, follows Jellyfin profile with English fallback), `'none'` (disabled), `'forced_only'`, or `'custom'`.
* `subtitle_language`: Prioritized comma-separated language codes/names (e.g. `'sl, en'`) used when `subtitle_mode` is `'custom'`. Automatically burns in graphical subtitles (PGS/VOBSUB) for Chromecast casting, or streams native WebVTT tracks with Closed Captioning (CC) in the browser player.

### In-Dashboard Browser Playback & Custom Play Actions (`modal_play_actions`)
* `enable_browser_player`: Boolean (default: `true`). Enables the direct in-dashboard HTML5 dialog player (`<jellyha-browser-player>`) across card actions and the More Info pop-up, with full Closed Captions (CC) subtitle support.
* `enable_custom_play_actions`: Boolean (default: `false`). When `true`, delegates More Information dialog play actions to the `modal_play_actions` array.
* `modal_play_actions`: List of target dictionaries controlling the More Info play button and target picker overlay:
  * `type`: `'browser'`, `'cast'`, or `'script'`.
  * `name` (Optional, string): Custom label displayed on button or in target picker (e.g. `"Watch in Browser"`, `"Living Room TV"`, `"Play on Apple TV"`).
  * `icon` (Optional, string): Custom MDI icon (defaults: `mdi:monitor` for browser, `mdi:cast` for cast, `mdi:play` for script).
  * `device` (String, required for `cast`): Target `media_player` entity ID.
  * `service` (String, required for `script`): Target script entity ID.
  * `service_data` (Optional, dict): Extra arguments passed to script.
  * `show_entity_name` (Optional, boolean, default `true`): Set to `false` to hide the entity subtitle in the target picker list.

### Custom Interactions (`click_action`, `hold_action`, `double_tap_action`)
* **Available Actions**: `more-info` (default), `play-browser`, `cast`, `jellyfin`, `trailer`, `call-service` ("Run Script"), `none`.
* **When set to `play-browser`**: Immediately launches the in-dashboard `<jellyha-browser-player>` dialog with authenticated media stream resolution via HA's WebSocket API (`media_source/resolve_media`).
* **When set to `call-service`**:
  * In the card editor, Home Assistant renders a native `<ha-selector>` entity dropdown picker strictly filtered to `domain: 'script'` (`click_service`, `hold_service`, `double_tap_service`), complete with friendly names, icons, and live search.
  * In YAML, specify the script entity ID (e.g. `click_service: script.play_on_apple_tv`).
  * `click_service_data` (or `service_data`): Optional dictionary of static parameters merged into the service payload.
* **Automatic Metadata Injected into Script Variables**:
  When tapped, the card automatically injects all media item metadata as top-level execution variables directly into the script's Jinja template context:
  * **Core Identifiers & Playback**:
    * `item_id`: Jellyfin item GUID string (e.g. `"d8f34a8e..."`)
    * `title` / `name`: Item title or episode title (e.g. `"John Wick: Chapter 2"`, `"Episode 1"`)
    * `media_type`: `"Movie"`, `"Series"`, `"Episode"`, `"Audio"`, `"MusicAlbum"`
    * `dynamic_range`: String (`"Dolby Vision"`, `"HDR10"`, `"HLG"`, `"SDR"`)
    * `video_range_type`: String (`"DOVIWithHDR10"`, `"DOVIWithEL"`, `"HDR10Plus"`, `"HDR10"`, `"SDR"`)
    * `video_codec`: String (e.g. `"hevc"`, `"av1"`, `"h264"`)
    * `dv_profile`: Integer or null (Dolby Vision profile number, e.g. `7`, `8`, `5`)
    * `year`: Release year integer (e.g. `2017`)
    * `runtime_minutes`: Runtime duration in minutes (e.g. `122`)
    * `genres`: List of genre strings (e.g. `["Action", "Thriller"]`)
    * `rating`: Community rating float (e.g. `7.5`)
    * `is_played`: Boolean (true if marked watched)
    * `is_favorite`: Boolean (true if favorited)
    * `jellyfin_url`: Direct URL to item in Jellyfin web client
    * `path` / `filepath`: Server disk file path to media file (e.g. `"/media/movies/The Matrix (1999)/The Matrix.mkv"`), ideal for routing to external players (Kodi, MPV, VLC)
    * `action_type`: Interaction type string (`"click"`, `"hold"`, or `"double_tap"`)
    * `config_entry_id` / `entry_id`: Home Assistant config entry ID string
  * **TV Shows & Episodes**:
    * `series_name`: Parent TV show name string (e.g. `"Cape Fear"`), null for movies
    * `series_id`: Parent TV show GUID string, null for movies
    * `season`: Season number integer (e.g. `1`)
    * `episode`: Episode number integer (e.g. `3`)
    * `series_poster_url`: Parent show's portrait cover poster URL (for episodes)
  * **Music (Tracks & Albums)**:
    * `artist` / `artist_name`: Track or album artist string (e.g. `"Hans Zimmer"`)
    * `album`: Album title string (e.g. `"Interstellar (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack)"`)
    * `album_artist`: Primary album artist string
  * **Dates & Timestamps**:
    * `date_created` / `date_added`: ISO 8601 timestamp string when added to Jellyfin (e.g. `"2026-09-08T11:20:00Z"`)
    * `last_played_date`: ISO 8601 timestamp string of last playback (or null if unplayed)
  * **Artwork & Synopsis**:
    * `poster_url`: Authenticated, signed proxy URL to primary portrait poster
    * `backdrop_url`: Authenticated, signed proxy URL to fanart / backdrop image
    * `overview` / `description`: Plot synopsis or album description string
    * `official_rating`: Content age certification string (e.g. `"PG-13"`, `"R"`, `"TV-MA"`)
* **Custom Event**:
  The card also dispatches a `jellyha_item_clicked` DOM event with the exact same payload dictionary, enabling event-based automation triggers (`trigger: event, event_type: jellyha_item_clicked`).

### Example Script Template Receiving JellyHA Card Variables
```yaml
sequence:
  - action: system_log.write
    data:
      message: >
        Tapped {{ media_type }}: {{ title }} ({{ year }}) [{{ dynamic_range }}]
        {% if media_type == 'Episode' %}Series: {{ series_name }} S{{ season }}E{{ episode }}{% endif %}
        {% if artist %}Artist: {{ artist }} | Album: {{ album }}{% endif %}
        Date Created: {{ date_created }}
        Poster: {{ poster_url }}
      level: info

  # Route playback to external player (Apple TV, Infuse, Kodi, Plex)
  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ media_type == 'Episode' }}"
    then:
      - action: media_player.play_media
        target:
          entity_id: media_player.apple_tv_living_room
        data:
          media_content_type: tvshow
          media_content_id: "{{ jellyfin_url }}"
```
